note: Patient-side urgency wording for the bedside assistant: first-person acute distress happening now (fainting, cannot breathe, chest pain, a fall, bleeding now, unbearable pain) or a call for the nurse right now. Bare words such as urgent, emergency, immediately, help me, bleeding or a call for the doctor are not enough: they appear in ordinary questions. Same keyword forms and negation handling as red_flags.v2.json (whole tokens; <<word>> is a whole Arabic token). Not clinically validated.
